title: 片開き窓ユニット
description: 透明ガラス入りの二枚建て窓。片側の開いたサッシ、気密材、丁番、ハンドル、排水隙間のある水切りを含む。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A twin glazed casement unit with one sash statically open, transparent panes, seals, hinges, handles and a sill with real drainage gaps. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
